langHint: All explanations and settings will use this language. You can change it later.
deviceHint: We checked your computer to suggest what suits it best.
gpuNone: No NVIDIA card, so it runs on the processor and is slower
recommendCloud: We recommend cloud mode with a free Gemini key: it listens and translates most accurately.
localCapable: Your computer is also strong enough for local mode, if you want to work offline.
localNot: Local mode needs a graphics card with 8 GB or more, so cloud mode suits this computer better.
engineCloudHint: Free, the most accurate listening and translation, needs internet.
engineLocalHint: No key and no internet, lower quality, needs a strong graphics card.
engineAdvancedHint: Pick one provider for listening and one for translating.
keyNone: Your choice does not need any key.
keyRejected: The provider refused this key. Check that you copied all of it.
keyShape: That does not look like a key. Check that you copied all of it.
keysMissing: Save the required keys before continuing.
toolsHint: The essentials download now, the rest only when you need them.
tool_timing_hint: Makes subtitles appear exactly when people speak.
tool_accuracy_hint: A free listening model that runs on your graphics card, detects the language of the clip by itself and double-checks the timing.
tool_dubbing_hint: Clones each person's voice and keeps the music.
tool_local_translation_hint: A translation model on this computer. Needs the Ollama app.
requiredMissing: Download the essential tools before continuing.
extHint: Translate any video while browsing, with a right-click or the extension button.
extStep1: Open the extensions page in Chrome (chrome://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
extStep2: Press Load unpacked and choose this folder:
extStep3: Open the extension and press Connect automatically. A request will appear here for you to allow.
pairAsk: A browser extension wants to connect to tarjim
doneHint: Start with your first video: drop a file or paste a link.
dropHint: Any video or audio from your computer, in any language.
badFile: That file is not a video or audio file.
voiceClone: Each speaker's own voice (on this computer)
empty: Nothing translated yet. Drop a file above or paste a link.
err_quota: The free quota is used up for today. It comes back tomorrow, or use local mode.
err_key: The key is missing or was refused. Check it in Settings.
err_download: Could not download the video from that link. Check that the link works.
err_tools: ffmpeg is not installed on this computer.
err_dub: No dubbing voice for this language yet. Try subtitles instead.
engineSubscriptionHint: Translate with the plan you already pay for, through its own app on this computer. No keys.
subscriptionNone: Claude Code or Codex was not found on this computer. Install one, sign in with your plan, then come back.
connectHint: Pick what suits you: a key from any provider, your monthly subscription, or a model running on this computer.
subscriptionInstall: This subscription's app is not installed. Install it with this command, sign in with your account, then press Check again.
subscriptionReady: The app is installed. Press Sign in and your browser opens so you can sign in to your account.
localNone: No AI program is running on your device yet.
connectNotReady: That choice is not ready: add the key, install the app, or start the local model.
chatHint: Add tarjim to the chat app you use, then just say "translate this link".
chat_codex_hint: ChatGPT in the terminal and the Codex app.
chatRestart: Restart the Claude app to see tarjim.
chatFailed: Could not add it. Make sure the app is installed.
keySet: Key saved (type a new one to replace it)
consentCheck: I have read and accept the {name} (non-commercial use only)
ffmpegLater: missing, we install it in the Tools step
gpuFix: To let tarjim use your graphics card (much faster local listening), run this once, then restart tarjim.
tool_ffmpeg_hint: Reads the video and burns the subtitles.
tool_ffmpeg_manual: Install it once yourself: on macOS run brew install ffmpeg, on Linux run sudo apt install ffmpeg, then check again.
localAfterFix: Your card is strong enough for local mode once you run the command below.
signInWaiting: Your browser opened. Sign in there; this page updates by itself.
signInCodeLabel: If the sign-in page shows you a code, paste it here
signInConsole: A window opened for this program. Sign in there, then come back here.
signInFailed: Sign-in could not start. Make sure the app is installed, then try again.
localInstalled: {name} is installed on your device but not running.
localStarting: Starting, this takes a few seconds.
localStartFailed: It did not start. Open the program yourself, then press Search my device.
localNoStart: Open {name}, turn on its local server, then press Search my device.
localSearchHint: With your permission, tarjim looks through your program folders for Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, llama.cpp and KoboldCpp. Nothing leaves your device.
localSearching: Searching your device, this can take up to 20 seconds.
localSearchNone: Nothing found. If the program is somewhere else, paste the path of its file here.
localPathBad: That is not a file tarjim knows. Use ollama.exe, lms.exe, Jan.exe, llama-server.exe or koboldcpp.exe.
welcomeHint: Pick how you want to get ready. You can change anything later from Settings.
welcomePrivacy: The check runs on this computer only. Nothing about your device leaves it.
path_auto_hint: tarjim checks your computer, suggests a complete plan, and downloads what it needs after you approve.
path_ai: Use the AI you already pay for
path_ai_hint: Sign in to Claude, ChatGPT or another subscription in your browser, and tarjim sets up the rest around it.
path_manual: Set it up step by step
path_manual_hint: Choose every setting yourself: language, device, AI, tools, extension and chat.
scanDone: Done. Here is what we found.
scanNoGpu: No graphics card tarjim can use
planHint: We chose what fits this computer. Change any line before you start.
planNothingToDownload: Nothing to download, everything is here.
planTotal: Total {gb} GB. You have {disk} GB free.
planDiskLow: There is not enough free space. Free some space first.
planApplyFailed: Could not save these choices. Check the lines above and try again.
reason_signed_in: You are already signed in, so translation uses your plan with no extra key.
reason_sign_in_first: Installed but not signed in. Use “Use the AI you already pay for” to sign in.
reason_key: Uses the key you already saved.
reason_local: Runs on your graphics card. Nothing leaves your computer.
reason_local_slow: Runs on this computer without a graphics card, so it will be slow.
reason_free_key: The free Gemini key from Google is the easiest start. It takes one minute to get.
listenLocalName: On this computer (free, runs on the graphics card)
reason_gpu: tarjim downloads this free listening model once, on any computer with a graphics card. It understands the language of the clip by itself, and the audio stays on your computer.
reason_cpu_slow: Without a graphics card, listening on this computer is several times slower than the video. Gemini is faster.
reason_gemini_listen: Gemini hears most languages very accurately. The audio of each clip is sent to Google.
need_key_gemini: Paste your free Gemini key. Get it from Google in one minute with your Google account.
progressHint: You can close this page; the downloads keep going.
progressFailed: A download stopped. Check your internet and try again.
readyHint: We tried a short translation with your choices.
selfTestFailed: The test translation did not work. Open Settings and check the connection.
aiTitle: Use the AI you already pay for
aiHint: Pick your subscription. tarjim opens its real sign-in page in your browser; no terminal, no keys.
aiInstalling: Installing, this takes a minute or two…
aiInstallFailed: Installing did not finish. Try again, or install it from its website.
aiListenNote: Subscriptions translate but cannot hear audio. After you sign in, tarjim listens on your graphics card or with a free Gemini key.
localNoModel: {name} is running but has no model yet.
localNoModelOther: Download a model inside {name}, then come back and press Search my device.
localModelDownloading: Downloading; you can follow it in the Tools step.
otherProvider: Another provider with a key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenCode Zen…)
reason_other: Opens the connection step, where you can paste a key from any provider.
aiFromSite: This app installs from its own website.
modelWhy: The suggested model balances accuracy and cost for subtitles. Pick a bigger one for extra accuracy, or a lighter one to save your plan.
aiPlanKey: Monthly plan: connect it by pasting the plan's key.
planTerms_opencode_go: Note: OpenCode says Go is designed for coding agents. Using it for translation may be outside its terms; read them before you connect it.
autostart: Start tarjim when this computer starts (recommended, runs without a window)
phoneHint: Send any video link from your phone to your own Telegram bot. This computer translates it and sends the result back, at home or away, on iPhone or Android.
phoneStep1: In Telegram, open BotFather, send /newbot and pick a name for your bot.
phoneStep2: Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it here. It stays in this computer's vault.
phoneError_token: That does not look like a bot token. Copy the whole line from BotFather.
phoneError_rejected: Telegram did not accept this token. Make a new one in BotFather and paste it.
phoneError_offline: Could not reach Telegram. Check the internet connection and try again.
phoneScan: Scan this code with your phone's camera, or open the link on your phone, then press Start in Telegram.
phoneQrAlt: Code that opens your bot in Telegram
phoneWaiting: Waiting for you to press Start. The code works for 15 minutes.
phonePaired: Your phone is paired with {bot}. Send it any video link.
phoneOnlyWhenOn: The bot answers while this computer and tarjim are running. Turn on starting with the computer in the device section.
phoneProblem_rejected: Telegram rejected the bot token. Make a new token in BotFather and connect again.
phoneProblem_elsewhere: Another computer is using this bot. Stop tarjim there, or give each computer its own bot.
phoneProblem_offline: Telegram cannot be reached right now. tarjim keeps trying on its own.
phone_welcome: Paired. Send me a link to any video and I will send it back translated.
phone_bad_code: This code has expired or is wrong. Get a new one from Settings in tarjim on your computer.
phone_help: Send me a video link, or the video itself if it is under 20 MB.
phone_file_big: This video is over 20 MB, which Telegram does not let bots download. Send its link instead.
phone_too_big: The video is over Telegram's size limit, so here is the subtitle file. The full video is on your computer.
phone_mode_saved: From now on I send back: {mode}
phoneReadyHint: Want to send links from your phone? Pair it with your own Telegram bot and get translations back anywhere.
phone_choose: What should I make of this video?
phone_choice_expired: This choice has expired. Send the link again.
phone_send_failed: I could not send the video, so here is the subtitle file. The full video is in your computer's Downloads folder.
updateAvailable: A new version of tarjim is out ({version}).
updating: Updating now. tarjim comes back by itself in a few minutes. Keep the computer on.
updateBusy: A translation is running. Let it finish, then update.
updateFailed: The update did not finish and the current version is running again. Try again in a while.
updateManual: This copy runs from source and is updated with git.
autoUpdate: Update tarjim automatically when a new version is out (it only asks once a day for the latest version number)
